SELECT count(DISTINCT t1.id_student) FROM studentInfo AS t1 JOIN studentRegistration AS t2 ON t1.code_module = t2.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t2.code_presentation AND t1.id_student = t2.id_student WHERE t1.final_result = 'Withdrawn' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM studentAssessment AS t3 JOIN assessments AS t4 ON t3.id_assessment = t4.id_assessment WHERE t3.id_student = t1.id_student AND t4.code_module = t1.code_module AND t4.code_presentation = t1.code_presentation)
